12401.name: The Narrow Crack In The Glacier

north.description: To the north lies The Glacier's End.

south.description: To the south lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

12401.description:
The crack runs on through the heart of the glacier, a slot of blue ice
barely wide enough for one traveller, its walls leaning together
overhead into a roof of cloudy ice. Light seeps through the ice in a
deep, strange blue, and every breath hangs before your face. North, a
brighter whiteness marks the glacier's end; south, the crack winds back
toward the mountains of the Northern Wilderness. The ice creaks and
ticks softly around you, as though the glacier were dreaming in its
sleep.

12403.name: The Glacier's End

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through the Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies The Narrow Crack In The Glacier.

12403.description:
Here the glacier ends in a great wall of dirty blue ice, streaked with
grit and studded with boulders, and a narrow crack splits it to the
south. Before the ice lies a waste of moraine, heaps of gravel and
stones dropped by the glacier and frozen together under a crust of snow.
North, beyond the moraine, the first dark pines of the Winterwood rise
in a silent wall. The cold here is deep and still, and the air smells of
snow.

extra_descs.ice wall glacier boulders:
Boulders as large as carts are locked in the ice like flies in amber,
and deep within it a long dark shape may be the trunk of some tree that
grew here before the glacier came. The ice has been carrying them for
longer than anyone can say.

12404.name: A Path Through the Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies The Glacier's End.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12404.description:
The path enters the Winterwood among young pines that have crept out
onto the moraine, their boughs bowed low under loads of snow. South, the
trees thin toward the glacier's end; west, the path leads deeper into
the forest. The snow is wind-packed and firm, and the passing of
travellers shows only as a line of shallow dents. A cold breath comes
off the ice, stirring the needles with a dry whisper.

12405.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through the Winterwood.

12405.description:
The path bends around a great boulder left behind by the glacier long
ago, now wearing a thick cap of snow and a beard of icicles. Eastward
the path returns to the edge of the forest; north, it winds on among
taller pines. The trees crowd closer here, and the light grows dim,
filtered through layer upon layer of snowy boughs. Your footsteps are
muffled almost to silence.

12406.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12406.description:
Tall black pines rise on every side, their trunks bare of branches for
many feet before they spread into dark crowns heavy with snow. The path
runs south past the great capped boulder and west deeper into the trees.
Between the trunks the snow lies smooth and unbroken, blue in the
shadows. Now and then a clump of snow slips from a high branch and lands
with a soft thump.

12407.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12407.description:
The path runs straight here between two ranks of pines, like the aisle
of some vast and frozen hall. Old blazes hacked into the bark at head
height mark the way east and west, the wounds long since healed into
scars crusted with amber resin. The air smells sharply of pitch and
cold. High above, the wind combs the crowns of the pines with a sound
like distant surf.

12408.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12408.description:
A frozen stream crosses the path, its surface a sheet of grey ice
beneath which water can be heard chuckling faintly. Logs have been laid
side by side across it to make a crude bridge, now glazed with ice and
treacherous underfoot. The path runs on east and west from the stream.
Hoarfrost feathers every dead stem along the banks, and the pines lean
close over the water.

12409.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12409.description:
The path turns at the foot of a lightning-struck pine, split from crown
to root and charred black, yet somehow still standing. East lies the
frozen stream and its bridge of logs; south, the path continues among
the trees. Snow has drifted into the split trunk, filling it like mortar
between stones. The neighbouring pines seem to keep their distance from
the ruined tree, as if it were cursed.

12410.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12410.description:
The path dips into a hollow where the snow lies deep and soft, and each
step sinks to the knee. North lies the lightning-split pine; west, the
path struggles out of the hollow and on through the forest. A ring of
young firs stands buried to the shoulders in drifts, only their dark
tips showing. A line of wolf tracks crosses the hollow, each print set
neatly in the one before.

12411.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12411.description:
The path runs along a low ridge where the wind has scoured the snow
thin, and the brown needles of the forest floor show through in patches.
East, it drops into the hollow of deep snow; west, it keeps to the
crest. The pines on the ridge have been wrung by the wind into strange,
crooked shapes. Between their trunks the white land falls away into a
blue dimness.

12412.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12412.description:
The path swings around the roots of a giant pine torn up by some winter
storm, its upended root plate standing taller than a man and hung with
icicles and frozen clods. North, the way continues alongside the fallen
trunk; east, it runs back along the ridge. The pit left by the roots has
filled with drifted snow. The crown of the tree lies somewhere far off
among the others, lost from sight.

12413.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12413.description:
The path runs beside the long fallen trunk, where the snow has drifted
against it in a smooth, curling bank. South, the way bends around the
great root plate; west, it reaches a clearing where paths meet. Small
tracks cross and recross the snow here, the neat prints of hares and the
straight-stepping line of a fox. Your breath hangs in the still air and
drifts slowly away.

12414.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12414.description:
Three paths meet in a small clearing among the pines, where the snow
lies trampled and grey. North, a path leads toward rising, rocky ground;
east, the way runs beside a fallen trunk; west, a fainter track wanders
off among the trees toward a scatter of boulders. In the middle of the
clearing stands a waymark post, carved with the figure of a stag and
capped with snow. The surrounding pines are tall and utterly still.

extra_descs.waymark post stag carved:
The stag is carved in a few deep, sure strokes, its antlers spreading up
the post. A real antler tine has been fixed into the top, grey and
weathered, and hunters still tie strips of red cloth below it for luck.

12415.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12415.description:
The path climbs gently northward as the ground begins to rise toward a
ridge of rock. South, it returns to the clearing with the waymark post.
Pines grow here from cracks in the boulders, their roots clutching the
stone like the fingers of old men. Snow lies heaped on every rock and
branch, and icicles hang in fringes from the outcrops.

12416.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12416.description:
The rising ground grows steeper, and the path picks its way north
between boulders and the knuckled roots of pines. South, the way slopes
back toward the clearing. A frozen spring has spilled a fan of white ice
down the face of one great boulder, rippled like a curtain caught in a
draught. The trees creak and groan in the wind, a sound like ships at
anchor.

12417.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Mountain Path.

12417.description:
The path reaches the foot of a rocky ridge, where a narrow way leads up
into a dark cleft in the rock. East, the main path runs on along the
foot of the ridge; south, it returns among the boulders. The mouth of
the cleft is half choked with drifted snow, and a cold draught sighs out
of it. Pines lean out over it from the ridge, their roots clinging to
bare stone.

12418.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12418.description:
The path follows the foot of the ridge before turning north into deep
forest. West, it returns to the snowy mouth of the cleft. Icicles as
long as spears hang from an overhang of the ridge, and the snow beneath
them is pocked with holes where their drips have fallen. Northward the
trees stand dark and dense, a wall of black trunks.

12419.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12419.description:
The path runs through a stand of ancient pines, their trunks so thick
that three men could not link arms around them. Their bark is deeply
furrowed and stained with old resin, and their boughs meet high overhead
in a dark, unbroken canopy. Little snow reaches the ground beneath them,
and the path is a carpet of brown needles. The way leads north and south
between the giants.

12420.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12420.description:
The ancient pines give way to younger trees, and the snow returns, lying
deep and powdery on the path. North, the way leads to a meeting of
paths; south, it enters the stand of great old pines. Through gaps in
the branches the sky shows hard and pale as a sheet of tin. A cold wind
sighs through the treetops, and loose snow sifts down in glittering
veils.

12421.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12421.description:
Three ways meet here in the deep forest beside a great boulder glazed
with ice. East, a narrow path slips between close-set firs; south, the
way returns through the young pines; west, the main path runs on into
the trees. Above the junction the crowns of the pines part to leave a
ragged window on the sky. By night the stars burn cold and close through
it, and the snow gleams faintly in their light.

12422.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12422.description:
The path turns north among dark spruces, whose branches droop under such
loads of snow that they almost touch the ground. East, it leads back to
the junction by the icy boulder. Heaps of snow that have slid from the
branches lie in mounds beside the path. The forest is so silent here
that the creak of your own boots seems loud.

12423.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12423.description:
The path passes through a stand of larches, bare of needles for the
winter, their thin branches etched black against the pale sky. South, it
returns among the spruces; west, it continues through the forest. The
snow beneath the larches is bright, catching all the light that the
pines deny. The narrow slots of deer tracks cross the path in a hurried
line.

12424.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12424.description:
The path turns north at the edge of a frozen pond, a round sheet of ice
dusted with snow and ringed with brittle reeds. East, the way runs back
through the larches. Now and then the ice groans and cracks with the
cold, a deep sound that seems to come from everywhere at once. Pines
stand around the pond like a ring of silent watchers.

12425.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12425.description:
The path runs along a narrow neck of ground between the frozen pond and
a steep bank studded with stones and roots. North, it leaves the pond
behind; south, it returns to the edge of the ice. Dead reeds poke up
through the snow, rattling in the wind. Under the ice, where the snow
has blown clear, the dark shapes of sunken logs can be glimpsed.

12426.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12426.description:
The path turns west here, climbing away from the pond onto higher ground
among old pines. South, it returns along the shore. An old hunter's
lean-to of poles and bark slumps against a pine trunk, half buried in
snow and long abandoned, its roof fallen in. The forest grows darker
ahead, and the pines taller.

12427.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12427.description:
The path follows a broad ridge through dark pines, east toward the old
lean-to and west into deeper forest. Wind roars in the treetops, though
little of it reaches the ground, and snow shaken from the branches
drifts down like fine flour. The trunks are plastered with ice on one
side where wind-driven snow has frozen against them. Everything around
you creaks and sighs.

12428.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12428.description:
The path dips into a shallow ravine, crossing a frozen stream bed on
stepping stones capped with ice. East and west, the way climbs out of
the ravine among the pines. Icicles hang from the walls of the ravine in
long ranks like organ pipes, and water can be heard trickling somewhere
beneath the ice. The cold in the shadow of the ravine is sharp enough to
sting the eyes.

12429.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12429.description:
Out of the ravine the path turns north, winding through a stand of pines
toward a rise. East, it returns to the ravine and its frozen stream. Old
stumps, felled by axes long ago, stand in the snow like grave markers,
each topped with a round white cushion. Someone once logged these woods,
though no one now remembers who, or where the timber went.

12430.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12430.description:
The path crosses the top of a rise among scattered pines that let in the
pale light. South, it returns among the old stumps; west, it runs along
the crest. From here you can see between the trunks across a wide
stretch of snowy forest, black and white to the edge of sight. The wind
is keener on the rise, and it finds every gap in your clothing.

12431.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12431.description:
The path runs along the crest of the rise between pines bent all one way
by the wind. East and west the way continues along the crest. A snow-
covered cairn of rounded stones stands beside the path, built by some
long-gone traveller to mark the way. The wind has carved the snow around
it into rippled waves and sharp little cornices.

12432.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12432.description:
The path drops gently into a thicket of young firs, grown so close
together that their branches interweave above the path. East and west,
the way pushes on through the thicket, and you must stoop beneath the
lowest boughs. Snow sifts down through the branches in a fine,
glittering dust. The air is still and close, and smells of resin.

12433.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12433.description:
The path comes out of the fir thicket and turns south beside a great
boulder split clean in two by frost, with a young pine growing in the
crack. East, the way returns through the thicket. Ahead, a steep slope
of rock rises above the trees, crusted with ice and streaked with frozen
meltwater. The snow here is churned by the tracks of many beasts.

12434.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Mountain Path.

12434.description:
The path runs along the foot of the steep, rocky slope, where a narrow
mountain path leads up along a ledge onto the mountainside. North, the
way returns toward the split boulder; west, the main path continues
through the forest. Boulders lie half buried in drifts at the foot of
the slope. Pines cling to the rock above, their roots gripping it like
claws.

12435.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12435.description:
The path threads through a stretch of windthrown pines, trees flattened
by some great storm and lying in a crisscross tangle. East, it returns
to the foot of the rocky slope; west, it winds on between the fallen
trunks. Upturned roots stand like walls, hung with icicles and frozen
earth. Snow fills every gap between the trunks, hiding holes deep enough
to break a leg.

12436.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12436.description:
Beyond the windthrow the path turns south into an older part of the
forest. East, it returns through the tangle of fallen trunks. The pines
here are tall and straight, and around each trunk the snow has sunk into
a deep, hidden well. A careless traveller who stepped off the path could
plunge into one up to the chest and never climb out.

12437.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12437.description:
The path runs on through the old forest, its snow packed hard by the
passage of feet and hooves. North, it returns to the edge of the
windthrow; west, it goes on beneath the pines. Lichen hangs from the
branches in long grey beards that stir in the faintest breath of air.
The silence is so deep that you can hear the snow settle.

12438.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12438.description:
The path runs east and west beneath pines whose trunks are scarred with
long claw marks, gouged deep into the bark far above the height of a
man's head. Some of the marks are old and grey; others are fresh and
still weep resin. The snow beneath the trees is churned and trampled.
Something large marks its ground here, and it does not care who knows
it.

12439.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12439.description:
The path turns south at the edge of a small clearing, where the snow
lies smooth and blue under an open sky. East, the way returns beneath
the clawed pines. When night falls the stars blaze fiercely over the
clearing, and the snow glitters back at them with its own cold light. A
ring of black pines stands around the edge like a fence.

12440.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12440.description:
The path runs west from the clearing through a stretch of forest where
many of the trees are dead, their bark peeled away and their branches
bare. North, the way returns to the clearing. The dead trees stand
silver-grey and gaunt among the living pines, riddled with the holes of
woodpeckers. When the wind blows they knock together like bones.

12441.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12441.description:
The path turns south here and begins a long, gentle descent through the
forest. East, it returns among the dead trees. The ground falls away
ahead and the pines begin to thin, their trunks more and more bent by
the wind. Through gaps between them, a wide white country shows beyond
the edge of the wood, empty and glaring under the pale sky.

12442.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12442.description:
The path slopes gently southward among pines that grow farther and
farther apart. North, it climbs back toward the dead trees. The snow on
this slope lies deep, drifted by the wind into long ridges with knife-
sharp crests. A frozen creek runs beside the path, its course marked by
a line of snow-buried willows whose red twigs are the only colour for
miles.

12443.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12443.description:
The path follows the frozen creek south through a little gully it has
carved over the years. North, the way climbs the slope again toward the
dead trees. The ice of the creek is clear as glass in places, showing
pebbles and strings of trapped silver bubbles beneath. Snow-laden
junipers crowd the banks, their berries a dusty blue.

12444.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12444.description:
Here the creek bends away into a tangle of willow scrub, and the path
leaves it, turning west across rolling ground among scattered pines.
North, the way follows the creek back into its gully. A wooden sledge,
broken-backed and half buried in snow, lies abandoned beside the path,
its runners grey with age. The snow is hard-crusted here and squeaks
underfoot.

12445.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12445.description:
The path runs south through the thinning forest, where the pines stand
apart and lean away from the wind. East, it returns toward the creek and
the broken sledge. Snow drives between the trunks in stinging gusts, and
drifts have piled against the windward side of every tree. The edge of
the forest cannot be far off now.

12446.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies The End of The Winterwood.

12446.description:
The path runs south between the last of the great pines, battered and
bent by the wind that sweeps in from the open land. North, it returns
into the shelter of the forest. Ahead, beyond the trees, the land opens
into a white emptiness under a vast pale sky. Snow lies drifted high
against the trunks, carved into smooth, curving shapes.

12447.name: The End of The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies Entering the Winterlands.

12447.description:
Here the Winterwood ends, its last pines standing bent and broken at the
edge of an open waste of snow. South, the way into the Winterlands is
closed by a great barrier of storm-felled pines and drifted snow, piled
higher than a man's head and frozen solid. North, the path leads back
into the forest. The wind howls across the open land beyond, carrying a
stinging haze of snow.

extra_descs.barrier pines felled drifts:
The fallen pines lie crisscrossed as if flung down by a giant's hand,
their branches locked together and cemented with ice. No one will pass
this way into the Winterlands until a long thaw comes.

12448.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12448.description:
The fainter track leaves the clearing with the waymark post and turns
south among the pines, narrow and little used. East, it returns to the
clearing. The way winds between boulders and the trunks of old trees,
and snow lies drifted against the rocks in smooth banks. Somewhere
ahead, the land rises toward a dark outcrop of rock.

12449.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12449.description:
The track runs north and south between scattered boulders, each wearing
a tall white cap of snow. Pines grow among them, their roots wrapped
tight around the stones. A trickle of meltwater has frozen into a glassy
ribbon across the path, slick as oil. The forest is very quiet here, and
the light is grey.

12450.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Cave.

12450.description:
The track ends at the foot of a rocky outcrop, where a small cave opens
to the west, dark and low. North, the way returns among the boulders.
The snow before the cave mouth is trampled and stained, and a rank
smell, like old meat, drifts out of the dark. Icicles hang from the lip
of the outcrop like a row of teeth.

12451.name: A Small Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12451.description:
This small cave is low and dark, its ceiling so close that a tall man
must stoop. The floor is strewn with matted fur and scraped stone, and
the walls are scored with deep claw marks. The air is stale and heavy
with the reek of a den, and colder even than the snow outside. East, the
cave mouth opens onto the snowy forest, a dim grey shape against the
dark.

12452.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12452.description:
The narrow path winds between close-set firs whose snowy branches brush
your shoulders and shower you with powder. North, it goes on deeper into
the wood; west, it returns to the junction by the icy boulder. Few feet
come this way, and the snow on the path lies smooth. A small spring
trickles from beneath a rock, edged with ice that never quite closes
over it.

12453.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

north.description: To the north lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12453.description:
The path climbs gently through a stand of birches, their white bark
peeling in papery curls and their bare twigs a purple haze against the
snow. North, the way continues among them; south, it returns among the
firs. The birches stand ghostly pale against the dark pines beyond. Snow
lies in the forks of their branches like tufts of raw wool.

12454.name: A Path Through The Winterwood

east.description: To the east lies The End of a Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12454.description:
The ground grows rocky here and the trees thin, so that a tall cliff of
grey stone can be seen rising beyond them, gleaming with ice. The path
turns east toward the foot of the cliff and runs back south among the
birches. Boulders fallen from the cliff lie half buried in snow. In the
stillness you can hear a faint trickle of water hidden somewhere beneath
the ice.

12455.name: The End of a Path

west.description: To the west lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12455.description:
The path ends at the foot of a sheer cliff, down which a waterfall has
frozen into a great cascade of blue-white ice, all pillars and curtains
and spikes. Behind the ice the water still runs, a faint, secret sound
like whispering. There is no way onward, and the only path leads back
west through the thinning trees. Frozen spray has glazed every rock and
twig nearby, so that the whole place glitters.

extra_descs.waterfall ice cascade frozen:
The frozen fall is as tall as a tower, its folds and pillars glowing
deep blue where the ice is thickest. Bubbles hang trapped inside it like
strings of pearls, and here and there a thin dark thread shows where
water still slides behind the ice.

12456.name: A Narrow Mountain Path

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

down.description: To the down lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12456.description:
A narrow path climbs along a ledge of rock above the forest, with a
sheer drop on one side and a wall of icy stone on the other. Down below,
the path returns to the forest floor; south, it leads onto a high shelf
where a large cluster of great trees grows. Ice glazes the ledge, and
the footing is perilous. From here the tops of the pines spread out
beneath you like a dark, snow-dusted sea.

12457.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12457.description:
The path enters a great cluster of ancient pines growing on a high shelf
of the mountainside. North, it returns to the narrow, icy ledge; east,
it winds on among the trees. These pines are huge and gnarled, their
trunks twisted as though wrung by giant hands. The snow among them lies
deep and soft, and swallows every sound.

12458.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12458.description:
The path winds east and west among the great pines of the cluster. A
massive pine has fallen across the way, and a passage has been sawn
through its trunk, the cut faces dark with age and ringed with hundreds
of years of growth. The air smells strongly of resin. Snow has piled
along the top of the fallen giant like the crest of a frozen wave.

12459.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12459.description:
Three ways meet among the giant pines. East, the path continues through
the cluster; south, the trees open onto a snowy glade; west, the way
leads back past the sawn trunk. At the junction stands the hugest pine
of all, with a hollow at its base large enough for a man to shelter in.
Snow lies in deep drifts between its roots.

12460.name: A Narrow Mountain Path

south.description: To the south lies A Small Cluster Of Trees.

down.description: To the down lies A Path Through The Winterwood.

12460.description:
The narrow path squeezes through a cleft in the ridge, roofed over by a
great fallen slab and a cornice of hard snow, so that you walk in a dim,
close tunnel of rock. At its lower mouth the path leads back down to the
forest below. South, the cleft opens into a small cluster of trees. The
walls are rimed with frost, and every breath and footstep echoes back at
you.

12461.name: A Small Cluster Of Trees

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Cluster Of Trees.

12461.description:
A small cluster of firs grows here so densely that their snow-laden
branches meet in a roof overhead, shutting out all but a dim green
light. North, a path leads back into the rocky cleft; west, the trees
close in around a hidden hollow. The air beneath the boughs is still and
almost warm after the bite of the wind. The ground is a soft carpet of
needles, barely dusted with snow.

12462.name: A Small Cluster Of Trees

east.description: To the east lies A Small Cluster Of Trees.

12462.description:
The firs close in here around a tight, hidden hollow, walled by crowding
trunks and roofed by boughs bent low under their burden of snow. A gap
between the trunks leads back east to the rest of the cluster. A rough
platform of lashed poles has been built among the low branches, an old
hunter's cache, empty now and furred with frost. The silence is so
complete that you can hear your own heart.

12463.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12463.description:
Here the giant pines draw back around a snowy glade, open to the sky.
North, a path leads back to the hollow pine; east, the way goes on among
the trees. Hoofprints wander across the smooth snow, pausing here and
there where something has pawed down to the grass. Withered stems poke
through the drifts, and in summer this must be a meadow.

12464.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

south.description: To the south lies A Short Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12464.description:
The path leads south toward the mouth of a short cave in a rocky bank,
while the way north returns among the giant pines and the way west opens
into a snowy glade. Large clawed tracks lead to and from the cave, sunk
deep in the snow. The nearby trees are scarred and broken, their lower
branches snapped off. A sour, musky smell drifts on the air.

12465.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12465.description:
The pines here are so large that the path must wind between their roots,
which hump up through the snow like the backs of buried beasts. East,
the way runs on toward a rocky outcrop; south, it goes deeper among the
trees; west, it returns to the hollow pine. Snow-capped boulders lie
scattered among the trunks. The light is dim and grey, and very still.

12466.name: A Large Cluster Of Trees

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

up.description: To the up lies A Rocky Northern Outlook.

12466.description:
The cluster of pines ends against a rocky outcrop, where a way climbs up
the rocks to a lookout above the trees. West, the path leads back among
the giant pines. The rocks are crusted with ice and drifted snow, and
the wind is stronger here. Footholds have been worn into the stone by
those who have gone up before you.

12467.name: A Rocky Northern Outlook

down.description: To the down lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12467.description:
You stand atop a rocky outcrop high above the forest, and the whole
Winterwood lies spread out below, a vast sea of black pines dusted with
white. Beyond the forest a glacier glitters in the pale light, and far
off snowy peaks fade into grey haze. By night the stars burn here with a
fierce, cold brightness, so close it seems you could pluck them. A way
leads back down the rocks to the trees.

12471.name: A Short Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cluster Of Trees.

12471.description:
This short cave runs only a little way into the rock before ending in a
rough wall. Its floor is a mess of trampled filth and scraped stone,
darkened here and there with old frozen blood. The air reeks of a
beast's den, thick and sour, and the walls are scored with claw marks.
North, the cave mouth opens onto the snowy forest, a pale square of
light.

652100.name: snow owl bird
652100.long_desc: A snow owl sits hunched on a low bough, its round golden eyes following your every move.
652100.description:
Its plumage is white as new snow, flecked with black at the wing tips,
and so thick and soft that the bird looks twice its true size. It turns
its head almost all the way around to watch you, then blinks once,
slowly. Talons like hooked needles grip the bough beneath it.

652101.name: white stag deer
652101.long_desc: A white stag stands motionless among the pines, its breath smoking in the cold air.
652101.description:
Its coat is the pure white of fresh snow, and its antlers branch wide
and pale as frosted twigs, with a dozen tines or more. It holds its head
high and still, nostrils flaring, ready to bound away at the first wrong
step. Old scars on its flanks tell of wolves it has outrun.

652102.name: winter wolf
652102.long_desc: A winter wolf slinks between the trees, pale as the snow and silent as a shadow.
652102.description:
It is bigger than any wolf of the lowland woods, with a thick coat of
white and silver fur and eyes the pale blue of glacier ice. Frost rimes
the fur about its muzzle, and when it bares its teeth its breath hangs
in a cold cloud. Where there is one, the rest of the pack is seldom far
away.

652103.name: frost troll
652103.long_desc: A frost troll crouches in the gloom, its blue-white hide glittering with rime.
652103.description:
Taller than two men and gaunt as a dead tree, it has skin of a corpse-
pale blue crusted with frost that never melts, and long arms ending in
black claws. Icicles hang from its matted hair and beard. The cold rolls
off it like a draught from an open door, carrying a stench of old meat.

752100.name: antler white stag
752100.room_desc: A pale, many-tined antler lies here.
752100.description: A great branching antler, pale as bone and smooth as polished ivory, with eleven sharp tines. Carvers and hunters prize the antlers of the white stags of the Winterwood and pay well for them.

752101.name: cloak pelt wolf frost fur
752101.room_desc: A thick cloak of silver-white wolf fur lies here.
752101.description: The whole pelt of a winter wolf, silver-white and thick enough to turn a blizzard, cured stiff by the cold and tied at the throat by its own forelegs. The wolf's head forms a hood, its jaws framing the wearer's brow.

752102.name: bow pinewood pine longbow
752102.room_desc: A long bow of pale pinewood lies here.
752102.description: A hunter's longbow of pale, close-grained pine, backed with sinew and wrapped at the grip with strips of fur. Whoever owned it last came to a bad end, but it still draws smooth and true.

752103.name: club root pine rime
752103.room_desc: A heavy club of twisted pine root lies here, furred with frost.
752103.description: A club torn from the root of a great pine, gnarled and heavy, its knotted head studded with stones hammered into the wood. Frost forms on it even beside a fire.
